title: Unforgettable Day in Cadiz
text:
Our full day trip to Cadiz from Seville was one of the highlights of our time in southern Spain.  Our guide, Franco, was a delight! This experience felt more like exploring a new place with an old friend than simply a structured tour.  

Our trip happened to be during Carnaval de Cadiz.  Parts of the city were packed and chaotic, but Franco smoothly adapted the plan, rerouted us when needed, and made sure we never missed out on meaningful sights and experiences. Despite the festive crowds, the day never felt rushed or stressful.

We would absolutely recommend this trip for a great introduction
author: Melissa L
